meteor.module.crystalaura.description: Automatically places and detonates End Crystals for PvP.
meteor.module.esp.description: Highlights entities or blocks through walls.
meteor.module.freecam.description: Allows you to move your camera freely outside your body.
meteor.module.jesus.description: Allows you to walk on water.
meteor.module.safewalk.description: Prevents you from walking off the edge of blocks.
meteor.module.scaffold.description: Automatically places blocks beneath you while walking.
meteor.module.autototem.description: Automatically equips a totem in your off-hand when in danger.
meteor.module.nametags.description: Enhances player nametags by displaying health and armor.
meteor.module.tracers.description: Draws lines to entities around you.
meteor.module.velocity.description: Modifies or cancels knockback from attacks and explosions.
